sentences.en: Dad went to the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 爸爸去到这超市。

sentences.en: He took Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 他拿 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: He wanted them to help.
sentences.zh: 他想要他们到帮助。

sentences.en: "You can choose some cereal," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 你能选择一些谷物， 说爸爸。 Gran， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Do you want cornflakes?"
sentences.zh: 做你想要小麦小薄片？

sentences.en: "Can we get some crunch butts?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 能我们得到一些嘎吱嘎吱地嚼芽？ 问 Biff。 但是如何？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "All right," Said Dad, "just for a treat."
sentences.zh: 全部正确的！

sentences.en: They went to the cheese counter.
sentences.zh: 他们去到这奶酪柜台。

sentences.en: A lady was selling special cheese.
sentences.zh: 一个女士是卖特别的奶酪。

sentences.en: "This is Dutch cheese," said the lady.
sentences.zh: 这个是荷兰的奶酪， 说这女士。 帮助！ 喊这女士。

sentences.en: "It is called Edam.
sentences.zh: 它是叫 Edam。

sentences.en: It is made in Holland."
sentences.zh: 它是做在……里这荷兰。

sentences.en: The lady let them taste some Edam cheese.
sentences.zh: 这女士让他们味道一些 Edam 奶酪。

sentences.en: "I like it," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: There was a special offer.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个特别的提出。

sentences.en: "Buy two cheeses and you get a free baseball cap," said the lady.
sentences.zh: 买二奶酪和你得到一个自由的棒球运动便帽， 说这女士。 帮助！ 喊这女士。

sentences.en: Dad bought two cheeses and gave the cap to Chip.
sentences.zh: 爸爸买二奶酪和给这便帽到 Chip。

sentences.en: "That's not fair," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 那是不公正的， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: So, in the end, Dad bought four cheeses.
sentences.zh: 爸爸买四奶酪。

sentences.en: ExIT Dad took the shopping to the car.
sentences.zh: 爸爸拿这商店到这汽车。

sentences.en: There was a lot to carry.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个许多到搬运。

sentences.en: Dad put the cheeses on top of the car.
sentences.zh: 爸爸放这奶酪在……上顶的这汽车。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 哦不！

sentences.en: He forgot all about them and drove off with the cheeses on the roof.
sentences.zh: 他忘记全部关于他们和驾驶离开和……一起这奶酪在……上这屋顶。

sentences.en: "Why are people waving at us?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 为什么是人们波浪在我们？ 问 Biff。 但是如何？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: A dog ran into the road.
sentences.zh: 一个狗跑进入这路。

sentences.en: Dad stopped suddenly.
sentences.zh: 爸爸停突然地。

sentences.en: The cheeses slid off the roof.
sentences.zh: 这奶酪滑行离开这屋顶。

sentences.en: They fell on to the road and rolled down the hill.
sentences.zh: 他们落下在……上到这路和使滚动向下这小山。

sentences.en: "Help!" Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ Gran， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: He ran after the cheeses.
sentences.zh: 他跑在……之后这奶酪。

sentences.en: "It's chase the cheese," laughed Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是茶色这奶酪， 笑 Biff。 哦不， 笑 Wilf。

sentences.en: "Poor old Dad," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 爸爸， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Two of the cheeses were run over by a lorry.
sentences.zh: 二的这奶酪是跑在……上方由一个卡车。

sentences.en: They were squashed flat.
sentences.zh: 他们是拥挤水平的。

sentences.en: One was badly dented.
sentences.zh: 一是差凹痕。

sentences.en: Only one was alright.
sentences.zh: 只有一是全部正确的。

sentences.en: Dad pulled a face.
sentences.zh: 爸爸拉一个脸。

sentences.en: "What a shame!" He said.
sentences.zh: 什么一个羞愧感！ 他说。

sentences.en: "You sound cheesed off," laughed Biff.
sentences.zh: 你声音奶酪离开， 笑 Biff。 哦不， 笑 Wilf。

sentences.en: "It's not funny," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 它是不有趣的， 说爸爸。 Gran， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: At home, Biff and Chip went to Biff's room.
sentences.zh: 在家， Biff 和 Chip 去到 Biff 房间。

sentences.en: They wanted to play some music.
sentences.zh: 他们想要到玩一些音乐。

sentences.en: Suddenly the key glowed.
sentences.zh: 突然地这钥匙光亮。

sentences.en: "It's time for an adventure," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了一个冒险， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I hope it's not an adventure about cheese," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我希望它是不一个冒险关于奶酪， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The magic took them back in time.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to Holland.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们到这荷兰。

sentences.en: They were on a high bank called a dyke.
sentences.zh: 他们是在……上一个高的岸叫一个堤。

sentences.en: On one side the land was very flat.
sentences.zh: 在……上一私德这陆地是非常水平的。

sentences.en: On the other side was the sea.
sentences.zh: 在……上这其他私德是这海。

sentences.en: The dyke kept the sea away from the land.
sentences.zh: 这堤保持这海离开从这陆地。

sentences.en: Chip looked around.
sentences.zh: Chip 看圆形的。

sentences.en: "There are windmills everywhere," he said.
sentences.zh: 那里是风车到处， 他说。

sentences.en: "I think we're in Holland."
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在……里这荷兰。

sentences.en: "The land is very flat," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这陆地是非常水平的， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "But I can't see any houses." "Come on," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我不能看见任何房子。 来在……上！ ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Let's try to find a village."
sentences.zh: 让我们尝试到找到一个村庄。

sentences.en: They began to walk.
sentences.zh: 他们开始到走。

sentences.en: A horse and cart came along.
sentences.zh: 一个马和大车来沿着。

sentences.en: A boy was driving it.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩是驾驶它。

sentences.en: On the back of it were some large round cheeses.
sentences.zh: 在……上这回来的它是一些大的圆形的奶酪。

sentences.en: "How far is it to the nearest village?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 如何远是它到这在……附近村庄？ 问 Biff。 但是如何？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "It's quite a long way," said the boy.
sentences.zh: 它是相当一个长的方式， 说这男孩。 我的名字是 Hans， 说这男孩。

sentences.en: "Jump up on the cart.
sentences.zh: 跳向上在……上这大车。

sentences.en: I'll give you a lift." Said the boy.
sentences.zh: 我会给你一个拿起。 我的名字是 Hans， 说这男孩。

sentences.en: "My name is Hans," said the boy.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Hans， 说这男孩。

sentences.en: "I'm taking these cheeses to market." "I'm Biff," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我是拿这些奶酪到市场。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "And this is Chip." "What funny names!" Said Hans.
sentences.zh: 和这个是 Chip。 什么有趣的名字！ 说 Hans。

sentences.en: The horse began to trot.
sentences.zh: 这马开始到小跑。

sentences.en: The cheeses began to bump around in the back of the cart.
sentences.zh: 这奶酪开始到撞在……周围在……里这回来的这大车。

sentences.en: "This cart looks a bit old," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 这个大车看一个一小块旧的， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Should you go so fast?" "No," Said Hans.
sentences.zh: 应该你去所以快的？ 现在！ ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "No," said Hans, "but I'm late for market.
sentences.zh: 不， 说 Hans， 但是我是晚的为了市场。

sentences.en: I have to sell all these cheeses."
sentences.zh: 我有到卖全部这些奶酪。

sentences.en: They went past a man on a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 他们去过一个男人在……上一个自行车。

sentences.en: "Slow down," Called Biff.
sentences.zh: 她慢的向下。 快的！ 叫喊 Biff。

sentences.en: At that moment a wheel came off the cart.
sentences.zh: 在那个片刻一个车轮来离开这大车。

sentences.en: "Oh help!" Shouted Biff.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 哦不！ 喊 Biff。

sentences.en: The cheeses slid off and rolled round the man on the bicycle.
sentences.zh: 这奶酪滑行离开和使滚动圆形的这男人在……上这自行车。

sentences.en: "Look out!" Shouted the man.
sentences.zh: 看。 嗨！ 喊这大的男人。

sentences.en: He fell off his bike and his cheese bounced out of his basket.
sentences.zh: 他落下离开他的自行车和他的奶酪反弹出的他的篮子。

sentences.en: The man jumped up and down with rage.
sentences.zh: 这男人跳向上和向下和……一起狂怒。

sentences.en: "Look at my bike!" He shouted.
sentences.zh: 看在我的自行车！ 他喊。 拉！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "And where's my cheese?
sentences.zh: 和哪里我的奶酪？

sentences.en: Which one of these cheeses is mine?"
sentences.zh: 哪个一的这些奶酪是我的？

sentences.en: Hans looked at all the cheeses on the ground.
sentences.zh: Hans 看在全部这奶酪在……上这地面。

sentences.en: "What does it matter?" He said.
sentences.zh: 什么做它事情？ 他说。

sentences.en: "They're all the same.
sentences.zh: 他们是全部这同样的。

sentences.en: Pick any one."
sentences.zh: 拿任何一。

sentences.en: The man picked up the cheeses.
sentences.zh: 这男人挑选向上这奶酪。

sentences.en: He looked at each one.
sentences.zh: 他看在每个一。

sentences.en: "I must find my cheese," he shouted.
sentences.zh: 我必须找到我的奶酪， 他喊。

sentences.en: At last he found it.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他找到它。

sentences.en: "This one is mine," he said.
sentences.zh: 这个一是我的， 他说。

sentences.en: Hans looked at the broken cart.
sentences.zh: Hans 看在这打破大车。

sentences.en: "I'll never get these cheeses to market now," he groaned.
sentences.zh: 我会从不得到这些奶酪到市场现在， 他呻吟。

sentences.en: "Let's carry them," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 让我们搬运他们， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "We'll help you."
sentences.zh: 我们会帮助你。

sentences.en: Hans put the cheeses in some sacks.
sentences.zh: Hans 放这奶酪在……里一些大口袋。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip helped him carry them.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 帮助他搬运他们。

sentences.en: The sacks were heavy and it was hard work.
sentences.zh: 这大口袋是重的和它是困难的工作。

sentences.en: The road was very long and straight.
sentences.zh: 这路是非常长的和直的。

sentences.en: It ran along the top of the dyke.
sentences.zh: 它跑沿着这顶的这堤。

sentences.en: The sea was just below the road.
sentences.zh: 这海是刚刚在这路。

sentences.en: "Phew!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: This sack is heavy," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个大口袋是重的， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Suddenly they heard someone shouting.
sentences.zh: 突然地他们听见某人喊。

sentences.en: It was a girl.
sentences.zh: 它是一个女孩。

sentences.en: They ran to see what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们跑到看见什么是错误的。

sentences.en: Water was spouting through the dike.
sentences.zh: 水是嘴穿过这堤。

sentences.en: The girl was trying to stop it.
sentences.zh: 这女孩是令人厌烦的到停它。

sentences.en: "Help!" She shouted.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 她喊。

sentences.en: The girl held her hands over the leak but water was still pouring through.
sentences.zh: 这女孩拿着她手在……上方这裂缝但是水是仍然瓢泼的穿过。

sentences.en: "My name is Trudy," she said.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Trudy， 她说。

sentences.en: "We must stop the water.
sentences.zh: 我们必须停这水。

sentences.en: If the hole gets bigger, the dyke will burst."
sentences.zh: 如果这洞得到大的， 这堤将使破裂。

sentences.en: "If that happens, there will be a terrible flood," said Hans.
sentences.zh: 如果那个发生， 那里将是一个可怕的洪水， 说 Hans。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The hole was getting bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 这洞是得到大的和大的。

sentences.en: The water began to pour through even faster.
sentences.zh: 这水开始到倒出穿过竟然快的。

sentences.en: They couldn't stop it with their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们不能停它和……一起他们的手。

sentences.en: Biff had an idea.
sentences.zh: Biff 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Push the cheeses into the hole," she said.
sentences.zh: 推这奶酪进入这洞， 她说。

sentences.en: "They have wax around them.
sentences.zh: 他们有蜂蜡圆形的他们。

sentences.en: They might keep back the water."
sentences.zh: 他们可能保持回来这水。

sentences.en: Chip pulled the sacks down the bank and they pushed the cheeses into the hole.
sentences.zh: Chip 拉这大口袋向下这岸和他们推这奶酪进入这洞。

sentences.en: "We need one more," said Trudy.
sentences.zh: 我们必须一更多， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: Just then the man went past.
sentences.zh: 刚刚然后这男人去过。

sentences.en: "Help us, please," yelled Hans.
sentences.zh: 帮助我们， 请， 叫喊 Hans。 是， 请！

sentences.en: "The dike is leaking."
sentences.zh: 这堤是裂缝。

sentences.en: "Now I'm in a hurry," Said the man.
sentences.zh: 不， 我是在……里一个急忙， 说这男人。 什么一个狗！ 说这男人。

sentences.en: They filled the hole as well as they could.
sentences.zh: 他们充满这洞像好像他们能。

sentences.en: Water still came through in places.
sentences.zh: 水仍然来穿过在……里地方。

sentences.en: "I'll have to go and get help," Said Trudy.
sentences.zh: T'll 有到去和得到帮助， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: "But why wouldn't that man help us?"
sentences.zh: 但是为什么不会那个男人帮助我们？

sentences.en: Jip went with Trudy.
sentences.zh: Chip 去和……一起 Trudy。

sentences.en: Biff and Hans stayed to try and stop the leak getting worse.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Hans 停留到尝试和停这裂缝得到更坏的。

sentences.en: Trudy and Chip ran to a windmill.
sentences.zh: Chip 跑到一个风车。

sentences.en: "I hope someone is there who can help us," said Trudy.
sentences.zh: 我希望某人是那里谁能帮助我们， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: Near the windmill, they saw the man's bike.
sentences.zh: 在……附近这风车， 他们看见这男人自行车。

sentences.en: It was leaning against a fence.
sentences.zh: 它是倾斜的紧靠着一个分册。

sentences.en: "That's odd," Said Jip.
sentences.zh: 那是奇怪的， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I thought that man was in a hurry."
sentences.zh: 我想那个男人是在……里一个急忙。

sentences.en: Trudy and Chip looked through the window.
sentences.zh: Chip 看穿过这窗户。

sentences.en: The man was inside.
sentences.zh: 这男人是里面。

sentences.en: He had a knife.
sentences.zh: 他有一个刀。

sentences.en: He was cutting the cheese in half.
sentences.zh: 他是切这奶酪在……里一半。

sentences.en: "Why is he doing that?" Said Jip.
sentences.zh: 为什么他做那个？ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "It looks like he doesn't want anyone to see him." "Shhh," "Ssh!" whispered Trudy.
sentences.zh: 它看喜欢他不想要任何人到看见他。 低语 Trudy。 哦， Hugh！ 她低语到 Hugh。

sentences.en: Inside the cheese were some diamonds.
sentences.zh: 里面这奶酪是一些钻石。

sentences.en: "I'm so clever," Laughed the man.
sentences.zh: 我是所以聪明的， 笑这男人。

sentences.en: "No one will find out that I stole the diamonds.
sentences.zh: 不一将找到出那个我 stole 这钻石。

sentences.en: The cheese was a clever place to hide them."
sentences.zh: 这奶酪是一个聪明的地方到把他们。

sentences.en: "He's a thief," whispered Chip.
sentences.zh: 他是一个小偷， 低语 Chip。 哦不！ 低语 Chip。

sentences.en: "We must do something."
sentences.zh: 我们必须做某物。

sentences.en: Trudy and Chip ran to find Trudy's father.
sentences.zh: Chip 跑到找到 Trudy's 爸爸。

sentences.en: They told him about the leaking dyke.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他关于这裂缝堤。

sentences.en: "We filled it up with cheeses," said Trudy.
sentences.zh: 我们充满它向上和……一起奶酪， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: "What year was that?" Asked Trudy's father.
sentences.zh: 是什么这事情？ 谁的主意是那个？ 问 Trudy's 爸爸。

sentences.en: Then Chip told him about the man with the stolen diamonds hidden in the cheese.
sentences.zh: 然后 Chip 告诉他关于这男人和……一起这 stolen 钻石 hidden 在……里这奶酪。

sentences.en: Trudy's father called the villagers and they ran to the windmill.
sentences.zh: Trudy's 爸爸叫这村民和他们跑到这风车。

sentences.en: The mayor was with them.
sentences.zh: 这市长是和……一起他们。

sentences.en: The thief was inside the windmill.
sentences.zh: 这小偷是里面这风车。

sentences.en: He was still looking at the diamonds.
sentences.zh: 他是仍然看在这钻石。

sentences.en: "Those diamonds belong to my wife," said the Mayor.
sentences.zh: 那些钻石属于某人到我的妻子， 说这市长。 谢谢你， 说这市长妻子。

sentences.en: "They belong from my house."
sentences.zh: 你 stole 他们从我的房子。

sentences.en: The villagers tied the thief to the windmill.
sentences.zh: 这村民租给雇工的这小偷到这风车。

sentences.en: "Help!" He shouted.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 拉！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "Let me down!"
sentences.zh: 让我向下！

sentences.en: "That will teach him," said Trudy.
sentences.zh: 那个将教他， 说 Trudy。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: "He wouldn't help us."
sentences.zh: 他不会帮助我们。

sentences.en: "Well, he can stay there until we fix the dike," Said the mayor.
sentences.zh: 好， 他能停留那里直到我们已经固定的这堤， 说这市长。 谢谢你， 说这市长妻子。

sentences.en: The villagers mended the dike.
sentences.zh: 这村民缝补这堤。

sentences.en: Hans helped, and so did Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 他拿 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: "Phew!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: This adventure is hard work," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个冒险是困难的工作， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "The cheeses were heavy but the sand is even heavier.
sentences.zh: 这奶酪是重的但是这沙是竟然重的。

sentences.en: "I don't want to see another cheese," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我不想要到看见另一个奶酪， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Hans looked worried.
sentences.zh: Hans 看发愁的。

sentences.en: "There will be no money this week," he said.
sentences.zh: 那里将是不钱这个星期， 他说。

sentences.en: "My cart is broken.
sentences.zh: 我的大车是打破。

sentences.en: Now I have no cheeses to sell." "Never mind," Said Trudy.
sentences.zh: 我有不奶酪到卖。 从不头脑， 说 Trudy。

sentences.en: "You helped save the dike."
sentences.zh: 你帮助挽救这堤。

sentences.en: "And we caught a thief," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 和我们抓住一个小偷， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Said Jip.
sentences.zh: ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Everyone went to the village.
sentences.zh: 每个人去到这村庄。

sentences.en: "Thank you," said the Mayor's wife.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。

sentences.en: "I got my diamonds back.
sentences.zh: 我得到我的钻石回来。

sentences.en: Here is a reward."
sentences.zh: 这里是一个报偿。

sentences.en: "Three cheers for Trudy and Hans and their friends," said the Mayor.
sentences.zh: 三向为了 Trudy 和 Hans 和他们的朋友们， 说这市长。 谢谢你， 说这市长妻子。

sentences.en: "They stopped a bad flood.
sentences.zh: 他们停一个坏的洪水。

sentences.en: Using cheeses was a brilliant idea.
sentences.zh: 我们奶酪是一个明亮的主意。

sentences.en: The magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: It was time for Biff and Chip to go.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了 Biff 和 Chip 到去。

sentences.en: Hans bought two cheeses from the market.
sentences.zh: Hans 买二奶酪从这市场。

sentences.en: He gave them to Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 他给他们到 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: They gave Hans and Trudy their baseball caps.
sentences.zh: 他们给 Hans 和 Trudy 他们的棒球运动大写字母。

sentences.en: "Goodbye," "Goodbye," they said.
sentences.zh: 再见， 他们说。

sentences.en: The magic took Biff and Chip home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿 Biff 和 Chip 家。

sentences.en: Dad came into Biff's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 爸爸来进入 Biff 卧室。

sentences.en: "Where are your free baseball caps?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 哪里是你的自由的棒球运动大写字母？ 他问。 我们已经丢失他们， 说 Biff。 这承载停。

sentences.en: Um ... we've lost them," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 好， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Dad was cross.
sentences.zh: 爸爸是叉形。

sentences.en: "He's cheesed off again," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 他是奶酪离开再一次， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。
